name: (HALOWEEN!!!) Grow a Tree Incremental
desc:
🌳 Grow a Tree Incremental is a game where you can grow your very own tree, collecting leaves and unlocking many new features! Compete against best people on the leaderboard and become the best tree grower! 🌳

💪 FOREVER F2P!!!!! 💪

🌳 Upgrade your tree to unlock new features
🍃 Collect leaves to buy new upgrades
🏭 Unlock new features, which will help you in further progression
🏆 Compete to become the best tree grower!!

✅ Join our community below for future sneak peeks for updates!

💻 Every update log is being added on our community server.
